images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied existing pizza food photo. Correct ONLY the onions. Remove ALL existing long white tubular onion rings, pale curved ribbons and stringy onion arcs. Replace those onion toppings with a modest amount of finely DICED ROASTED RED ONION: small flat angular 3-5mm square and diamond-shaped pieces, recognizable violet-purple outer skin edges and translucent lightly caramelized beige-pink layered interior. Natural baked vegetable texture, scattered sparingly and partly nestled into melted cheese. Absolutely no long strips, loops, tubes, strings, noodle-like pieces, worms or larvae-looking shapes. Keep ALL other toppings and ingredients, crust shape, round pizza size, exact camera viewpoint, framing, shadows, sharpness and lighting unchanged. The result must be an appetizing high-end real food photograph, not an illustration. Whole pizza entirely visible, no plate, no text or added props. Preserve transparent background outside the exact pizza silhouette. Keep the generous calabresa sausage rounds, mozzarella, tomato sauce and oregano. Exact 90-degree overhead centered square pizza, original diameter and small transparent margins.
